Maya: Quick thread for 'Community Builders Meetup' prep. Need: final speaker slide deck, courier for heavy banners, swag manifest, and lead capture flow.
Diego: Speaking submission got approved for Maya and Cass. Nina, can you confirm talk headshot + bio for the program by Thurs?
Nina: Yep — uploading headshot to drive now. Bio: 55 words, focusing on inference ops and cost wins.
Cass: Swag update: ordered 300 branded notebooks, 250 lip balm, 150 socks (yes socks). Courier said last pickup is 4/15 3pm. Should we insure the banners?
Maya: Yes insure banners. Well also have a small printed benchmark card (1 pager) showing inference latency + cost vs vanilla cloud. Diego, can you draft it? Keep it simple.
Diego: Will do. Also need QR -> Typeform -> HubSpot mapping. Proposed fields: name,email,company,interest_level,followup_type. Use UTM campaign=community_builders_may24.
LogiBot: Courier booking created (BigShip): AWB 1234567890. Pickup scheduled 2024-04-15 15:00.
Maya: Run-of-show: 10:00 load-in, 11:00 quick speaker check, 12:00 lunch & demo setup, 13:30 doors open, 14:00 talk, 15:00 booth teardown starts. Nina please own the run-of-show doc.
Nina: On it. Also adding a field to the QR form to tag which swag they claimed.
Cass: For packing: add 2x banner stands, 1x crate with foam, 1x spare gaffer kit, swag zip bags, power strip. Ill create the manifest and post the packing photo when loaded.
Maya: Messaging for small banner blurb: "Redwood Inference — Run LLMs where you need them. Fast. Predictable. Private." Thoughts?
Diego: Shorten to "Fast, predictable LLM inference" for headline. Use the longer line on the handout.
Maya: Agreed. Also we should have a short benchmarking narrative for the talk: 3 bullets (1. latency at scale, 2. cost per 1K tokens, 3. fallbacks & reliability). Diego will flesh out.
Cass: Logistics question: do we have a spare laptop for demos? I can bring one but would prefer a company unit.
Maya: We have one spare in /office/equipment but check battery health. If needed Cass can borrow Maya's as backup.
Diego: Reminder: Speaker slide deck due Thu EOD. Also for lead routing set a webhook to HubSpot and mark leads as source:community_builders so CS can triage.
LogiBot: Insurance purchased for banners: policy 98765, coverage $2,000.
Nina: Packing manifest created and uploaded: https://drive.example/redwood/meetups/community_builders/manifest.pdf
Maya: Final ask: anyone available to help load-in on Monday morning? 8:30 meet at office dock.
Cass: I can do 8:30.
Diego: Ill be there too.
Maya: Perfect. Ill consolidate and post the final run-of-show and the QR short link later today. :rocket:
